system.description:
“You don’t quite understand the situation you're in...do you boy?” Haizo bellowed out from the darkness he created with his Ninjutsu. “The Darkness is my ally, while you skulk through it, I was born of it. I have made it my partner in battle.” He speaks in a tone of assured victory, guaranteed of his success, his acute senses allow him to feel where his target is, a boy of average height who looks remarkably slim with long dark hair. Haizo begins to make his assault final as he rushes towards the boy who has been standing remarkably still the entire time. As Haizo enters striking range the boy reacts with monstrous precision striking Haizo in multiple points across his torso in the blink of an eye dispersing the Jutsu he had up, allowing light to shower the two. “But how!? It was total Darkness how did you know where I would strike!?” Haizo cried out. The boy stared at him, eyes pale white with veins running across his face leading both too and from his eyes as they stare almost through Haizo. “You overestimated yourself and underestimated my Byakugan, that was your fatal mistake” the boy said with a grin that would infuriate even the most composed of men.

—Tatsunami Aburame

The Long Road, Ch. 3 excerpt.

The Villages Strongest

The Hyūga Clan is one of the four noble clans of Konoha as well as the strongest clan in the village. All members born into this clan possess the Byakugan, a bloodline trait that gives them extended fields of vision and the ability to see through solid objects and even the Chakra circulatory system, amongst other things. Members of this clan also possess an innate ability which allows them to excel Chakra from any of the Tenketsu in their body. They are considered to be one of, if not currently, the most powerful clan in Konoha. Their fame and prowess stretch far and wide, leading others to both praise and covet their abilities.

The clan is separated into two parts: the main house and the branch house, a system that protects the secrets of the Byakugan from outsiders. The main house runs the family while the branch house protects it.

Hyūga Traits

Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Wis, +1 Dex

Speed: 30 feet.

Skill Proficiencies: Perception, Martial Arts

Dark Vision: Even without the power of a fully active Byakugan, you have Darkvision up to 30 feet.

Hyūga Hijutsu: The Hyūga Clan has access to a separate list of jutsu unique to their clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the normal jutsu list(s).

Hijutsu Flexibility: Hyūga Clan Hijutsu can use either Strength or Wisdom as its casting ability score.

Branch Family: The Hyuga are split between two different branches, the [Main Branch] and the [Side Branch]. The [Main Branch] acts as the nobles of the clan while the [Side Branch], the warriors or guardians. Select which branch your character is a part of. This determines some clan features or which Hijutsu you gain/have access to. This cannot be changed later.

Hyūga Features

Byakugan

1st Level Clan Feature

[Dojutsu]

One of the hidden Leaf village’s 2 great Dojutsu. The Byakugan is the All-seeing white eye. You may, as a bonus action you can activate this Dojutsu, which remains active for up to 10 minutes at a time, after which you require at least 10 minutes of non-use before you can activate it again. While active the Byakugan gains the following benefits:

All Seeing White Eye: You have 120 feet of Chakra Sight while out of combat and 60 feet while in combat. You can see through material up to 1 feet thick when taking the Search action. This perceptive strength grows at 7th level when you can see through material up to 5 feet thick within your chakra sight range. Your vision increases again at 11th level, granting you 500 feet of chakra sight outside of combat and 120 feet while in combat.

360° Vision: You can see in a 360-degree field around you without having to turn your head or avert your gaze. Creatures cannot be hidden from you without being Heavily obscured or behind total cover.

Gentle Fist

1st Level Clan Feature

In addition to the Byakugan, the Hyuga are known for their Gentle Fist stance. The Gentle Fist is the premiere fighting style for the Hyūga clan.

Also at 1st level, you learn the Taijutsu Stance of the Hyuga Clan, allowing you to use your clans Hijutsu ability modifier as defined by Hijutsu Flexibility while in this stance to make unarmed attacks and calculate [Unarmed Damage]. While in this stance you gain the following benefits.

Your [Unarmed Damage] die becomes a d8. This becomes 2d8 at 11th level.

Your [Unarmed Damage] becomes Chakra or Necrotic which you choose when you roll damage.

Your Hijutsu gain their Eight Trigram effect.

Beginning at 7th level, when you deal chakra damage to a creature with 0 chakra, you instead deal double the result as force damage to their hit points.

Beginning at 7th level, if you do not have the Extra Attack class feature, you can attack twice while in this stance when you take the Attack action.

Bloodline of the Elite

3rd Level Clan Feature

Your training with the secrets of the Hyuga has allotted you a plethora of abilities that help shape your technique and fighting style. Select 2 Hyuga Dogma’s which exemplify your skill within the clan. You gain one additional choice at 11th level.

Combat Insight

You gain amazing combat senses with or without your Byakugan. As a bonus action, while observing a creature, you can make an Identify (Ninjutsu, Genjutsu or Taijutsu/Bukijutsu, pick one) check against a creature you can see, vs their Level DC. On a success, you are able to learn of any one special action or ability they have that would qualify as or is similar to, the associated check.

Wisdom of the Court

The Hyuga are not jutsu warriors or martial artists. They are the Land of Fires most premier shinobi royalty. With this status comes the wisdom of managing such social circles. You can use Wisdom in place of Charisma for Persuasion and Intimidation checks.

Predictive Perception

Your ability to intuit danger, has been honed to near perfection. When a creature would make an attack against you at advantage, you can spend your reaction making them instead roll at disadvantage and gaining a rank of Mastery to your AC for the attack.

Sensory Type

As an Action, while exploring with your Byakugan active, you can perform a Perimeter Sweep ability. When you do, for the next 10 minutes, you and allied creatures with you, gain a rank of mastery to the next saving throw made against a triggered trap.

Cold Calculations

The clan has taught you to be practical, cold and calculative in all things. When you complete a long rest, you gain the Cold Calculus special action.

Cold Calculus. This special action can be used in place of your normal action or reaction for any Hyuga Hijutsu that requires it. Once this special action has been used, you cannot regain it until you complete a long rest.

Illusion Fist

A little-known secret of the Byakugan is that, when Genjutsu is focused through it, it becomes more focused, light sunlight though a magnifying glass. While in the Gentle Fist Stance, you can choose to make melee Genjutsu attacks, in place of unarmed attacks. These attacks, deal psychic damage when made this way.

Additionally, if you cast a Hyuga Hijutsu with Wisdom, you can change its damage type to Psychic, but counts as chakra or necrotic for other Hyuga clan features.

Tenketsu Needle

Once per turn, when you deal chakra damage to a creature with ranks of Sealed or Network Distortion, increase the chakra damage dealt by +2. This increases to +4 at 11th level.

Eight Trigrams – Sealing Technique

7th Level Clan Feature

[Main Branch]

The iconic fighting style of the Hyuga, doesn’t stop at just your martial arts, but in all forms of chakra-based warfare. When you cast a Jutsu that deals Chakra damage or has the Fuinjutsu keyword, you manifest the mythical Eight Trigrams sigil as part of its casting. Once per casting, one of the affected creatures that would attempt to cast a jutsu that requires chakra molding (CM) must make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest save DC. On a failure, their jutsu’s casting is Interrupted and gains a rank of Network Distortion.

Eight Trigrams – Internal Assault

7th Level Clan Feature

[Side Branch]

The iconic fighting style of the Hyuga, doesn’t stop at just your martial arts, but in all forms of chakra-based warfare. When you cast a Jutsu that deals necrotic damage or has the Medical keyword, you manifest the mythical Eight Trigrams sigil as part of its casting. Once per casting, one of the affected creatures that would attempt to cast a jutsu that requires chakra molding (CM) must make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest save DC. On a failure, they trigger the seal you placed as they gain 3 ranks of Network Distortion.

Eight Trigrams – Palm Bottom

11th Level Clan Feature

[Main Branch]

Your strikes are refined by the focus instilled into you by the main branch. Your strikes reaches deep into your foe, bludgeoning their internal organs. When you deal [Unarmed Damage] to a creature as a result of the Attack action with ranks of Sealed or Network Distortion you can dispel all ranks they have forcing them to make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failed save the affected creature is Staggered. They suffer a -1 penalty to their save for every 2 ranks of either condition dispelled in total. Once your use this feature you cannot do so again until the end of your next turn.

Eight Trigrams – Gentle End

11th Level Clan Feature

[Side Branch]

Your strike are efficient brutal, refined by the aggression instilled into you by the side branch. Your strike reaches deep into your foe, causing server internal damage. When you deal [Unarmed Damage] to a creature as a result of the Attack action with ranks of Sealed or Network Distortion you can dispel all ranks they have forcing them to make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest save DC. On a failed save the affected creature takes 1d6 necrotic and chakra damage for every rank dispelled in this way. They suffer a -1 penalty to their save for every 2 ranks of either condition dispelled in total. Once your use this feature you cannot do so again until the end of your next turn.

Heavenly Technique

15th Level Clan Feature

You take a single breath sharpening your Gentle Fist stance making each strike more precise and lethal than the last, making each strike accurately bludgeon the internal organs of your foes. You can assume this enhanced battle stance for one minute, after which you require a rest before you can use it again. For the duration you gain the following benefits:

Chakra damage you deal ignore DR (Damage reduction.)

When you make an unarmed attack that deals chakra damage, you deal an equal amount of damage to the target as Necrotic damage. If you would deal Force damage as a result of the target having 0 chakra, you instead simply double the necrotic damage you deal.

Each successful attack you make in the same turn, that deals Chakra or Necrotic damage increases the cost of the next Jutsu the affected creature casts by +2.
